section: Iterate - feature: keep a rejected lead decision and its reason
title: Rejected lead decisions go to an org-wide decisions-rejected.md; countersign takes a note
context: A rejected proposal was removed from decisions-proposed.md and only an audit line stayed, without the text; leads could propose the same thing again and never learned why it was refused. Leadwright reads the result, so the grammar is a cross-repo contract.
decision: Reject takes an optional one-line reason (600 chars, same quote guard as an edited line) and, under the decisions-proposed.md lock, writes the audit line with data.reason, then appends a block (heading, key marker, line, Rejected time, optional Reason) to <leadsRoot>/decisions-rejected.md atomically, deduped by identity, then removes the entry. Countersign takes an optional note logged as a - Note: item.
consequences: Leads can read every new rejection and its reason. Rejections before this change have no block. The file grows without bound; the reader trims. A fingerprint-less logged line block now always fails closed on residue. Grammar in docs/org-proposed-entry-contract.md, sample in server/src/external/org/__tests__/fixtures/decisions-rejected-sample.md.
rationale: Write order audit, block, removal keeps the text recoverable at every crash point; identity dedupe makes retries idempotent; one shared file is what the contract asked for and what leadwright reads.
rejected: A per-lead rejected file (leadwright wants one org-wide list); reading the reason back from the lead-writable audit file into the shared file (lead could plant operator words); copying fenced quotes or unfenced quote lines (every lead reads the file).
